name: Chicken and rice
steps: Rinse 1 cup rice. Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high. Brown chicken on all sides, then push it to the side of the pan.

Add the rice and 1½ cups water to the same skillet. Bring to a boil, cover, lower heat, and simmer about 12 minutes until the rice is tender and the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F (74°C) on a food thermometer.
Fluff the rice, mix in the chicken, and serve.

name: Egg fried rice
steps: Cook rice if you do not have leftovers: simmer 1 cup rice in 1½ cups water, covered, for 12 minutes, then spread on a plate to cool slightly.
Dice half the onion. Beat 2 eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Scramble the eggs until just set, push to the side, add onion for 2 minutes, then stir in rice. Cook 3–4 minutes until hot. Season and serve.

name: Chicken tortilla wrap
steps: Slice chicken into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken strips, stirring often, until browned and the thickest part reads 165°F (74°C) on a food thermometer.
Warm tortillas in the dry skillet for 30 seconds per side. Slice onion thin, fill tortillas with chicken and onion, roll, and serve.

name: Spinach and eggs
steps: Rinse spinach and shake dry. Beat 2 eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a nonstick pan over medium. Add spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Pour in eggs, stir gently until softly set, about 3 minutes. Serve immediately.
